text:
Zoe: Morning brain teaser: if you could rename the conference room whiteboard, what would you call it?
Carlos: "The Idea Mosh Pit" :collision:
Maya: "Scribble Sanctuary" :sparkles:
Ethan: "Oops, That Was Permanent" (for markers that never wash) :sweat_smile:
team-bot: Reminder: whiteboard photos get archived to /shared/whiteboards daily at 18:00.
Rae: Vote time! React :one: for Idea Mosh Pit, :two: for Scribble Sanctuary, :three: for Oops That Was Permanent.
Zoe: Also shoutout to Maya for rescuing the lost charger yesterday :heart:
Carlos: Who hid the fancy sticker roll? Asking for a team.
Maya: Not me. But I will trade a muffin for said stickers.
Ethan: I can confirm muffin trades work. Source: personal experience. :croissant:
Rae: Mini poll: coffee bar or tea corner meetup at 4pm? :coffee: :tea:
Zoe: Tea corner. Less jittery sprint planning.
Carlos: Coffee. Jitter fuels creativity. :zap:
team-bot: Poll created: "4pm beverage meetup" (coffee 3, tea 2)
Maya: If coffee wins, I'm bringing biscotti. If tea wins, I'm bringing biscuits. Either way I'm a winner.
Ethan: Also proposal: leave one marker always red. Chaos calibration.
Rae: Love it. Done. Red marker reserved.
Zoe: Closing thread — winners will be announced via emoji in 30 minutes. Keep one-liners coming.
